# Company Goals

**Last updated:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Lifecycle:** current
**Horizon:** <!-- e.g. 2026 H2 -->

> The strategy layer above epics. Each goal gets a stable ID (`G1`, `G2`, …) that
> epics link to via their `goal:` frontmatter field, so `/sk:task-status` can answer
> "which active work serves which goal", and an autonomous agent picking its next
> task prioritizes against strategy, not recency.
